title: The Delta-T Car
intent: Continue Aero-Disc thermal work into a fully passive vehicle that treats aerodynamic drag as the primary energy source via a deep φ-spiraling wet cone and low-ΔT heat engine.
eta_goal: Turn a pure loss (drag) into a net positive work stream while remaining low-embodied-energy.
core_framing: A deep golden-ratio (φ) spiraling cone forms the primary air path.
Closed-cell outer surface for structure; open-cell wet interior functions as continuous volumetric labyrinth.
Resulting temperature differential drives a low-ΔT Stirling or TEG array.
In the limit, aerodynamic power becomes the fuel rather than a pure loss.
optimized_query_patterns: Size the φ-spiral cone and wet media for target frontal area and cruise speed so generated ΔT is usable by a realistic LTD engine.
constraints: Must remain coherent with Aero-Disc findings
Safety and regulatory reality are first-class
verification_notes: Measured ΔT and power on instrumented subscale models.
next_physical_or_action: Build a small φ-spiral wet cone test article and measure temperature rise in controlled airflow.
